title: Common Tools and Extensions
summary: This module provides a collection of common tools and extensions for AI agents. It includes integrations with external search services (Exa.ai, Tavily), wrappers for frameworks (LangChain, ACI.dev), and native agent capabilities like code execution, memory, and RAG-based file search.

nodes.label: Exa Search Toolset
nodes.title: Exa Search Toolset
nodes.description: Provides a collection of Exa search tools (search, find_similar, get_contents, answer) with a shared client for efficient web search and content retrieval, optimizing API usage.

nodes.label: Tavily Search Tool
nodes.title: Tavily Search Tool Creator
nodes.description: Creates a configurable Tavily search tool for web search, allowing parameters like max results, search depth, and domain filtering to be set or exposed to the LLM for dynamic queries.

nodes.label: ACI.dev Toolset
nodes.title: ACI.dev Integration Toolset
nodes.description: Wraps ACI.dev functions into a toolset, enabling agents to interact with ACI.dev services and leverage their functionalities within the AI framework.

nodes.label: LangChain Toolset
nodes.title: LangChain Integration Toolset
nodes.description: Adapts LangChain tools into a compatible toolset, allowing agents to seamlessly leverage existing LangChain functionalities and integrations within the Pydantic AI ecosystem.

nodes.label: URL Context Tool (Legacy)
nodes.title: URL Context Tool (Legacy)
nodes.description: A deprecated alias for WebFetchTool, maintained for backward compatibility to deserialize old payloads. It provides functionality to fetch and process content from specified URLs.

nodes.label: Code Execution Tool
nodes.title: Agent Code Execution
nodes.description: Enables AI agents to execute code dynamically, supporting various LLM providers such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Bedrock, and xAI for enhanced problem-solving capabilities.

nodes.label: Memory Tool
nodes.title: Agent Memory Management
nodes.description: Provides AI agents with the capability to manage and utilize conversational or contextual memory, enhancing their ability to maintain state and recall information, currently supported by Anthropic.

nodes.label: File Search Tool
nodes.title: RAG File Search
nodes.description: Offers a fully managed Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for agents to search through uploaded files using vector search, supporting OpenAI, Google, and xAI for context injection.

nodes.label: Exa.ai Service
nodes.title: Exa.ai Web Search
nodes.description: External web search and content retrieval service providing advanced search capabilities, content extraction, and answer generation from the web.

nodes.label: Tavily.com Service
nodes.title: Tavily.com Web Search
nodes.description: External web search API service offering focused and configurable web searches with options for search depth, topic, and domain filtering.

nodes.label: ACI.dev Platform
nodes.title: ACI.dev External Platform
nodes.description: External platform offering various AI functions and services, integrated to extend the capabilities of agents within the Pydantic AI framework.

nodes.label: LangChain Framework
nodes.title: LangChain AI Framework
nodes.description: Popular external framework for developing applications powered by large language models, whose tools can be wrapped and used by Pydantic AI agents.

nodes.label: WebFetchTool (Capabilities)
nodes.title: WebFetchTool from Capabilities
nodes.description: The core WebFetchTool component residing in the capabilities_and_tools module, providing fundamental web content fetching functionality, aliased by UrlContextTool.

groups.label: Web & Data Tools
groups.title: Web & Data Tools
groups.description: Tools for searching the web, fetching content from URLs, and performing RAG-based file searches.

groups.label: External Integrations
groups.title: External Framework Integrations
groups.description: Toolsets designed to integrate with and wrap functionalities from external AI frameworks and platforms.

groups.label: Native Agent Capabilities
groups.title: Core Agent Capabilities
groups.description: Fundamental tools that provide agents with native abilities like code execution and memory management.
